applicability.physics: serial rigid cells with two principal bending hinges; fixed rigid attachments; straight frictionless tendons
applicability.collision: section convex hull extrusions; holes filled for collision only; exact polygon/circular area moments; guide box envelope

limitations: section convex hull extrusions; holes filled for collision only; exact polygon/circular area moments; guide box envelope
Direct bounded MuJoCo tendon force; tendon lengths are measured responses, not a real-robot constitutive law.
MATLAB lowest-envelope-vertex penalty and MuJoCo convex contact differ; no contact accuracy claim.

motion_summary.late_change_definition: last sampled error minus first sampled error in stated interval
motion_summary.scope: Sampled observations, not continuous-time guarantees or new acceptance criteria.

one_step_prediction_summary.scope: Only accepted first-step predictions matched to next execution timestamp; no future-plan replay comparison

diagnostic_limitations: Sampled observations do not identify a dominant cause.
Force proximity alone does not imply a required physical design change.
Ideal tensions; omitted shear, stretch, torsion, tendon friction and actuator dynamics.
